behavior: Require the exact root-owned approved request hash before any request.
Recheck the public non-invalidated elected round, job, reward revision and decision digest before each attempt.
Post only the original idempotent import, using the existing scoped review_operator credential; never follow redirects.
Retain original import responses; respect Retry-After and the fixed delivery deadline.
Stop on a changed election, unexpected refusal, successful import, verified existing exact approval, or deadline.
after_completion: Inspect the real completion record and independently verify public integrity/source approval and immutable evidence identities before any reward/source hold release. If uncertain or terminal, reconcile exact existing request state; do not create another review or reset an owner.
